digest.component_or_area: graph loader/BFS traversal, ticket unblock detection
propositions: Cross-level graph traversal must be refused by both current-side ticket_type guard and target-side _is_at_level guard; a direct cross-level edge whose far end is source_id is sensitive only to the target-side guard and must not yield a traversal result.
When reduce returns None and a tombstone is present with non-terminal status, a status-only stub must be created so the blocker status is loaded from the tombstone rather than treated as absent.
A present tombstone status must override the reduced status from the blocker directory, so a closed tombstone reading counts as closed regardless of the directory contents.
A malformed tombstone must degrade to 'deleted' status rather than to 'absent', so the blocker counts as closed via the fallback mechanism.
